title: Love Story

cues.en: We were both young when I first saw you
cues.zh: 當我初次遇見你時，我們都還很年輕
cues.text: We were both young when I first saw you

cues.en: I close my eyes and the flashback starts
cues.zh: 我閉上眼睛，閃回開始
cues.text: I close my eyes and the flashback starts

cues.en: I'm standing there
cues.zh: 我就站在那裡
cues.text: I'm standing there

cues.en: On a balcony in summer air
cues.zh: 在夏日空氣中的陽臺上
cues.text: On a balcony in summer air

cues.en: See the lights, see the party, the ball gowns
cues.zh: 看到燈光，看到派對，舞會禮服
cues.text: See the lights, see the party, the ball gowns

cues.en: See you make your way through the crowd
cues.zh: 看見你穿越人群走來
cues.text: See you make your way through the crowd

cues.en: And say, "Hello"
cues.zh: 說聲「你好」
cues.text: And say, "Hello"

cues.en: Little did I know
cues.zh: 我當時渾然不知
cues.text: Little did I know

cues.en: That you were Romeo, you were throwing pebbles
cues.zh: 你是羅密歐，你在投擲鵝卵石
cues.text: That you were Romeo, you were throwing pebbles

cues.en: And my daddy said, "Stay away from Juliet"
cues.zh: 我爸爸說「離茱麗葉遠一點」
cues.text: And my daddy said, "Stay away from Juliet"

cues.en: And I was crying on the staircase
cues.zh: 我在樓梯上哭泣
cues.text: And I was crying on the staircase

cues.en: Begging you, "Please don't go"
cues.zh: 求求你， “求求你不要走”
cues.text: Begging you, "Please don't go"

cues.en: And I said
cues.zh: 我說
cues.text: And I said

cues.en: "Romeo, take me somewhere we can be alone
cues.zh: 「羅密歐，帶我去一個可以獨處的地方
cues.text: "Romeo, take me somewhere we can be alone

cues.en: I'll be waiting, all there's left to do is run
cues.zh: 我會等著，剩下要做的就是跑
cues.text: I'll be waiting, all there's left to do is run

cues.en: You'll be the prince, and I'll be the princess
cues.zh: 你做王子，我做公主
cues.text: You'll be the prince, and I'll be the princess

cues.en: It's a love story, baby, just say yes"
cues.zh: 這是一個愛情故事，寶貝，只要說「是」
cues.text: It's a love story, baby, just say yes"

cues.en: So I sneak out to the garden to see you
cues.zh: 所以我偷偷溜到花園去看你
cues.text: So I sneak out to the garden to see you

cues.en: We keep quiet 'cause we're dead if they knew
cues.zh: 我們保持沈默，因為若被發現我們就完了
cues.text: We keep quiet 'cause we're dead if they knew

cues.en: So close your eyes
cues.zh: 所以閉上眼睛
cues.text: So close your eyes

cues.en: Escape this town for a little while, oh, oh
cues.zh: 離開這個小鎮一段時間，哦，哦
cues.text: Escape this town for a little while, oh, oh

cues.en: 'Cause you were Romeo, I was a scarlet letter
cues.zh: 因為你是羅密歐，我是一個猩紅字母
cues.text: 'Cause you were Romeo, I was a scarlet letter

cues.en: And my daddy said, "Stay away from Juliet"
cues.zh: 我爸爸說「離茱麗葉遠一點」
cues.text: And my daddy said, "Stay away from Juliet"

cues.en: But you were everything to me
cues.zh: 但你是我的一切
cues.text: But you were everything to me

cues.en: I was begging you, "Please don't go"
cues.zh: 我求你了， “求你不要走”
cues.text: I was begging you, "Please don't go"

cues.en: And I said
cues.zh: 我說
cues.text: And I said

cues.en: "Romeo, take me somewhere we can be alone
cues.zh: 「羅密歐，帶我去一個可以獨處的地方
cues.text: "Romeo, take me somewhere we can be alone

cues.en: I'll be waiting, all there's left to do is run
cues.zh: 我會等著，剩下要做的就是跑
cues.text: I'll be waiting, all there's left to do is run

cues.en: You'll be the prince, and I'll be the princess
cues.zh: 你做王子，我做公主
cues.text: You'll be the prince, and I'll be the princess

cues.en: It's a love story, baby, just say yes"
cues.zh: 這是一個愛情故事，寶貝，只要說「是」
cues.text: It's a love story, baby, just say yes"

cues.en: Romeo, save me, they're trying to tell me how to feel
cues.zh: 羅密歐，救救我，他們試圖告訴我
cues.text: Romeo, save me, they're trying to tell me how to feel

cues.en: This love is difficult, but it's real
cues.zh: 這份愛歷經艱辛，但它是如此真實
cues.text: This love is difficult, but it's real

cues.en: Don't be afraid, we'll make it out of this mess
cues.zh: 別害怕，我們會擺脫這場混亂
cues.text: Don't be afraid, we'll make it out of this mess

cues.en: It's a love story, baby, just say yes
cues.zh: 這是一個愛情故事，寶貝，只要說「是」
cues.text: It's a love story, baby, just say yes

cues.en: Oh, oh-oh
cues.zh: 哦，哦-哦
cues.text: Oh, oh-oh

cues.en: I got tired of waiting
cues.zh: 我已經厭倦了等待
cues.text: I got tired of waiting

cues.en: Wondering if you were ever comin' around
cues.zh: 不知道你是否曾經四處走動
cues.text: Wondering if you were ever comin' around

cues.en: My faith in you was fading
cues.zh: 我對你的信心逐漸消退
cues.text: My faith in you was fading

cues.en: When I met you on the outskirts of town
cues.zh: 當我在城郊遇見你的時候
cues.text: When I met you on the outskirts of town

cues.en: And I said
cues.zh: 我說
cues.text: And I said

cues.en: "Romeo, save me, I've been feeling so alone
cues.zh: 「羅密歐，拯救我吧，我一直感到如此孤單」
cues.text: "Romeo, save me, I've been feeling so alone

cues.en: I keep waiting for you, but you never come
cues.zh: 我一直在等你，但你永遠不會來
cues.text: I keep waiting for you, but you never come

cues.en: Is this in my head? I don't know what to think"
cues.zh: 這是在我的腦海裡嗎？ 我不知道該怎麼想」
cues.text: Is this in my head? I don't know what to think"

cues.en: He knelt to the ground and pulled out a ring
cues.zh: 他跪在地上，拿出一枚戒指
cues.text: He knelt to the ground and pulled out a ring

cues.en: And said
cues.zh: 然後說
cues.text: And said

cues.en: "Marry me, Juliet, you'll never have to be alone
cues.zh: 「嫁給我吧，茱麗葉，你永遠不會孤單
cues.text: "Marry me, Juliet, you'll never have to be alone

cues.en: I love you, and that's all I really know
cues.zh: 我愛你，這就是我真正知道的
cues.text: I love you, and that's all I really know

cues.en: I talked to your dad, go pick out a white dress
cues.zh: 我跟你爸爸談過，去挑一件白裙子
cues.text: I talked to your dad, go pick out a white dress
